tax.text: On his campaign website, Alford called for lower taxes as part of his economic agenda.
tax.quote: We must do everything in our power to right the wrongs of this feckless administration by reigning in federal spending, eliminating unnecessary regulations, lowering taxes, and implementing pro-growth policies to reignite our economy and allow Americans to thrive and prosper.

trade.text: Alford said he supported tariffs even if they made some goods cost more for consumers.
trade.quote: And if I have to pay a little bit more for something, I'm all for it to get America right again to start whittling down this $36.5 billion or trillion worth of debt that we have that's unsustainable.

debt.text: He voted against the Fiscal Responsibility Act because he said it did not cut debt or restrain spending enough.
debt.quote: the legislation does not go far enough to cut our debt, rein in federal spending levels, or make sure our military is properly funded

housing.text: Alford backed attracting regional growth and cited housing affordability and homeownership as goals in his congressional work.
housing.quote: As communities across the Fourth District expand and we continue our efforts to attract additional growth to the region, it’s vital that our roads and bridges keep up.

schools.text: He publicly supported expanding school choice for families.
schools.quote: House Republicans hear you, and we stand with you on expanding school choice.

safety.text: Alford said he would oppose defunding police and advocate increased funding for law enforcement.
safety.quote: I will always oppose the radical left’s efforts to Defund the Police and will advocate for increased funding to support the men and women who put their lives on the line every day to protect our communities.

immigration.text: Alford called for building a border wall, increasing border security officers, and enforcing existing immigration laws.
immigration.quote: Instead of demonizing the men and women who work hard to protect us from this invasion, we must secure our border by building the border wall, increasing border security officers, and better enforcing our existing immigration laws.

guns.text: Alford said he would oppose efforts that infringe on Second Amendment rights.
guns.quote: I will always fight tirelessly to ensure that no one infringes upon our Second Amendment rights.

abortion.text: Alford described himself as fully pro-life and said he would defend the rights of the unborn.
abortion.quote: I am 100% Pro-Life. I will always staunchly defend the right to life and protect the rights of the unborn.

gender.toward: rules based on sex at birth
gender.text: Alford voted for the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, which sets sports participation rules based on sex.
gender.quote: Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act

energy.text: Alford voted for the Lower Energy Costs Act in 2023.
energy.quote: Vote Question: On Passage Lower Energy Costs Act

housing.text: He supports expanding housing supply through large-scale development and other construction incentives.
housing.quote: We need to build more housing. That starts with treating this crisis with the urgency it deserves.

schools.text: He supports full funding for public schools and opposes policies that take funding away from them.
schools.quote: Policies that strip funding from public schools do not create choice; they create collapse.

trade.text: He says he opposes import tariffs and argues that trade wars harm consumers.
trade.quote: To be clear, I oppose any tariffs against any other country for imports.

schools.text: He criticizes charter schools as government-subsidized and favors more local control for parents.
schools.quote: Advocates for Charter Schools may find themselves disheartened, as this represents yet another method of government subsidization.

guns.text: He says he supports the Second Amendment and gun rights, while also recognizing private property owners’ authority to set rules.
guns.quote: They mean well regarding the 2nd Amendment, which I absolutely support.

abortion.text: He says medical decisions, in discussing abortion, should be left to patients and their doctors.
abortion.quote: On a personal level, I prefer to leave medical decisions up to the patients and their doctors.

cannabis.text: He supports fully legalizing marijuana and treating addiction as a medical crisis rather than a criminal one.
cannabis.quote: I would go further in supporting legislation that would fully legalize marijuana.
